programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:再苦也要笑一笑 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯救早產嬰兒的交通系統(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,簡稱 NETS)。在短短三年間,一共協助搶救了5437名初生及早產嬰兒。

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:再苦也要笑一笑 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 劉三論今-風風雨雨牽手情
programme.desc: 聖經上說:「人的怒氣,並不成就神的義」,你怎麼靠著神,在處理夫妻之間的矛盾中經歷得勝?創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯救早產嬰兒的交通系統(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,簡稱 NETS)。在短短三年間,一共協助搶救了5437名初生及早產嬰兒。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 本集Gigi姐會用太極豬做五香一字排，這種豬肉肥瘦均稱、肉質佳。Gigi姐曾在溫哥華用這道菜式宴請四哥謝賢，四哥嘗過後覺得它很適合用來下酒，並認為能夠拯救他的酒吧。Gigi姐亦會教大家一個醃肉的訣竅。

programme.title: 萬千星輝賀台慶粵
programme.desc: TVB「同心同行 闖新世代」，度過第58個璀燦年華，寓意於AI新時代繼續與觀眾並肩前行，跨步未來。台慶盛典由「阿姐」汪明荃帶領林盛斌、朱凱婷，以及龔嘉欣、陳曉華等擔綱司儀，召集眾多藝人一同慶賀TVB生辰。阿姐、胡楓客串時裝模特兒；陳豪、譚俊彥攜後輩藝員「薪火對話」；謝天華率陳詠詩等全女班舞動熱力；「好聲音」聯乘「聲夢」唱演音樂劇；福祿壽連結女神配對計劃「扮嘢」演出，幕幕精彩。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻：丙午年吉星高照年初一粵
programme.desc: 丙午馬年，TVB上下一心恭賀年初一。《中年好聲音》比拼「翻杯過三關」，熱唱賀年歌。森美、Eric Kwok與Plan V分成兩組挑戰《唱錢》，注入喜慶節奏。《Hands Up》姐姐引領小朋友「摘彩頭」，贏駿馬公仔。《J Music》聯乘「聲秀」唱將歡頌<四喜臨門喜迎春；三姐助陣《流行都市》，教煮應節小食，眾人還抽「幸運星」迎春接福。阿姐靚聲賀歲、胡楓化身「財神」派利是，加上醒獅獻瑞，齊心送祝福！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 大年初一，《流行都市》一眾主持與蘇民峰師傅向觀眾拜年。蘇師傅還帶來肖馬、肖羊、肖猴人士，在馬年的事業、愛情與健康運程預測。本命年屬馬者犯太歲，要特別留意甚麼？大王帶芝齡、菲比、芷倫，以及於圍村長大的吳大強一同新春行大運，走入元朗跟鄧達智拜年，並感受圍村舞獅賀歲的熱鬧氣氛。達智款待眾人在祠堂享用圍村賀年素食宴席，並介紹菜式的吉祥寓意。「睇餸食飯」，三姐呈獻素菜「袋袋黃金迎新歲」，祝大家馬年財源滾滾！

programme.title: 中年好聲音3紅白大戰粵
programme.desc: 支嚳儀、譚輝智分別率領男、女子組上演紅白大戰。王鄭浚仁並肩李創偉帶來<左鄰右里，對壘有「特別人馬」助戰的陳芷盈、阮慧珊<心急人上。接着，浚仁再上陣夥拍劉洋、占士丁丁高唱激勵英文歌；善玥澄、曹越等女子組同訴<給自己的情書。魔王級劉洋、陳芷盈、張與辰、黃博輪流登場獨唱，挑戰高難度曲目<浮誇、<夢中人、<餓狼傳說、<陀飛輪。同場加映，李金凱、趙浚承會跳唱於登峯之戰未有機會表演的決勝快歌。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 藤木弄丟了壓歲錢，原來被阿山撿到，更花了小部分請爸爸喝酒，小丸子要求爸爸把錢歸還。小丸子刨筆刨到心煩，恰巧見到姐姐有別人送的鉛芯筆，好生羨慕，爺爺於是替她把用短了的鉛筆黏合起來。

programme.title: 灼熱卡巴迪粵日
programme.desc: 宵越拒絕參加防守方的訓練，理由是俗稱「鎖鏈」的防守陣形，需要跟同性隊員手牽手。可是，在進攻訓練中，宵越卻又屢嘗敗績。為找出突破口，宵越決定細心觀察他的隊員，終於想出了必勝法，更宣言要完成帽子戲法。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 適逢農曆大年初一的喜慶日子，「My Little Show」舞台上亦響起賀年樂韻。十三位小朋友以童聲童氣大合唱<祝福你，為觀眾送上滿滿的新春祝福。接着有女生以古箏彈奏<鳳陽花鼓，延續喜氣。波波姐姐再次亮相節目，與一眾主持姐姐齊聲唱兒歌。這次她們特意配合農曆新年主題，唱出《親戚歌》、《歡樂年年》，喚起大家拜年、團聚的美好回憶。此外，波波姐姐亦會細談音樂中的大調、小調分別。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 小丸掉下的銅錢滾了下山。小丸為了找回銅錢一直追到去毒菇忍者的據點。亂太郎他們抵達兵庫水軍的據點時，遇到一個樣貌與第三協榮丸相同的人。金吾遵從戶部老師的建議，前往觀看劍豪的鬥瞪眼比拼。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 心房顫動是心律不正的一種，因心房不規則地跳動，心臟無法有效地將血液泵送至心室，導致心跳加速且不規律，症狀包括心悸、氣喘等，可引發許多健康問題，嚴重時甚至會增加中風風險。除了定期進行心臟檢查，養成健康的生活習慣都是預防心房顫動的重要一環。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某私人屋苑的室內泳池天花突然倒塌，所幸未造成任何人員傷亡。農曆大年初一，來自雲南的劉洋與李金凱準備了一席豐盛的賀年宴席，向觀眾介紹當地的節慶美食。有市民遭人冒認身份，在虛擬銀行成功開設戶口並借貸高達百萬元。追查發現，騙徒僅憑偽造證明文件便能通過審核，令人質疑審查機制存在漏洞。觀眾控訴某理財比較平台，指其宣稱提供的開戶禮品未能兌換，詳情如何？另會送上新春花車匯演的精彩綵排花絮。

programme.title: 2026國泰新春國際匯演之夜粵
programme.desc: 大年初一晚上，尖沙咀上演年度新春國際匯演，與廣大市民歡賀新歲！本屆盛會以「開年 開運 開心」為主題，十二輛融入駿馬與新春特色的花車耀目登場。來自本港、內地與世界各地的表演團隊參與巡遊，呈現英歌舞、戰旗雜技、活力啦啦隊、光影夢幻白馬、巨型彩色恐龍等多元文化魅力。歌手陳奐仁也會領銜「中年、聲夢、聲秀」唱將獻聲助興。主持陸浩明、朱凱婷引領觀眾感受慶典狂熱，曾展望、葉蒨文亦直擊喜氣洋洋的街頭巡遊氣氛。

programme.title: 新春保良迎金馬粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 宋宛穎、關嘉敏等以女團姿態跳唱<恭喜發財，施宇琪與袁文靜藉古箏、說唱表演和應。草蜢送上<華麗舞台賀馬年，並帶來新作<老的辣。布志綸祝大家<行得走得；周吉佩、張與辰合作傳遞新春喜悅，陳詠詩舞動絲帶助興；還有林奕匡、黃妍等獻聲支持保良局。馬德鐘、賴慰玲領軍大玩賀年版「以訛傳訛」遊戲，發放歡樂。吳若希、戴祖儀等藝人則外訪介紹機構的貼心支援服務。陳松伶壓軸登場獻唱新歌<松伶，為節目劃上溫馨句號。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#1粵
programme.desc: 項少龍等特警負責秦俑展覽會的保安，同僚發現其中一秦俑的樣貌跟少龍相似。富商李小超為展覽會剪彩，有狂徒扮記者混入，並以滿身炸藥挾持小超及少龍的公關女友秦青，幸少龍機智制服狂徒。秦青責少龍七年來一直逃避不結婚，向他發最後通牒。小超游說少龍參與穿梭時空實驗，少龍拒絕。少龍欲向秦青求婚，但秦青已赴外國結婚，為了讓時光倒流挽回秦青的心，答應跟小超合作。少龍坐時空穿梭機向秦朝出發，清醒時發現大批軍馬向他衝來。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#2粵
programme.desc: 殺手善柔與人生死搏鬥時，少龍從天而降救善柔一命。少龍知道身處趙國，請善柔帶他到秦都咸陽，以便回到現代。善柔卻帶他到邯鄲的武士行館投宿，少龍跟蹤善柔，期間聽到嚴平一眾正密謀毒殺元宗。少龍驚悉善柔是女兒身。善柔與少龍見到一老者遭流浪劍客欺負，仗義出手，善柔推斷他是元宗。嚴平欲以毒酒毒殺元宗，少龍與善柔及時相救。元宗是「墨者行會」傳人，嚴平欲奪其「鉅子令」號令會眾。元宗答應教少龍墨子劍法，嚴平突然尋至。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某私人屋苑的室內泳池天花突然倒塌，所幸未造成任何人員傷亡。農曆大年初一，來自雲南的劉洋與李金凱準備了一席豐盛的賀年宴席，向觀眾介紹當地的節慶美食。有市民遭人冒認身份，在虛擬銀行成功開設戶口並借貸高達百萬元。追查發現，騙徒僅憑偽造證明文件便能通過審核，令人質疑審查機制存在漏洞。觀眾控訴某理財比較平台，指其宣稱提供的開戶禮品未能兌換，詳情如何？另會送上新春花車匯演的精彩綵排花絮。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 大年初一，《流行都市》一眾主持與蘇民峰師傅向觀眾拜年。蘇師傅還帶來肖馬、肖羊、肖猴人士，在馬年的事業、愛情與健康運程預測。本命年屬馬者犯太歲，要特別留意甚麼？大王帶芝齡、菲比、芷倫，以及於圍村長大的吳大強一同新春行大運，走入元朗跟鄧達智拜年，並感受圍村舞獅賀歲的熱鬧氣氛。達智款待眾人在祠堂享用圍村賀年素食宴席，並介紹菜式的吉祥寓意。「睇餸食飯」，三姐呈獻素菜「袋袋黃金迎新歲」，祝大家馬年財源滾滾！

programme.title: 鼎爺做節攻略粵
programme.desc: 宴客菜要講體面，鼎爺率先帶來「甫魚刺參扒鵝掌」。甫魚又名大地魚、方魚，將甫魚乾以明火烘香後，配上鯪魚骨等食材製成鮮味湯膽；雪藏鵝掌經過汆水、油炸、蒸煮，再與海參同燜，置碟後淋上蠔油芡，撒上蝦子，賣相得體。過節美食亦講意頭，不妨來一道「家鄉鹹湯圓」。留意鼎爺示範搓粉糰技巧，怎樣可令湯圓不易裂開？用蝦米、冬菇等材料煮湯底，湯圓則裹入鯪魚肉、蝦米碎。細嚐大大粒湯圓配豐富湯料，滲出與別不同的家鄉味道。

programme.title: 中年好聲音3紅白大戰粵
programme.desc: 支嚳儀、譚輝智分別率領男、女子組上演紅白大戰。王鄭浚仁並肩李創偉帶來<左鄰右里，對壘有「特別人馬」助戰的陳芷盈、阮慧珊<心急人上。接着，浚仁再上陣夥拍劉洋、占士丁丁高唱激勵英文歌；善玥澄、曹越等女子組同訴<給自己的情書。魔王級劉洋、陳芷盈、張與辰、黃博輪流登場獨唱，挑戰高難度曲目<浮誇、<夢中人、<餓狼傳說、<陀飛輪。同場加映，李金凱、趙浚承會跳唱於登峯之戰未有機會表演的決勝快歌。

programme.title: 家家行運菜粵
programme.desc: 圍村人的「派門頭」，竟是分享添丁喜悅的獨特方法？王君馨、吳業坤和麥長青向圍村居民賀嫂和賀叔偷師炮製兩道賀年菜— 寓意添丁發財的「茨菰炆豬肉」和長命百歲的「粉絲蝦米黃芽白」，吃過這些好意頭的圍村賀年菜，馬年定會事事順利！「行運嘉賓」高鈞賢和陳智燊兩位在外國長大的型男主廚，分別帶來中西合璧的「富貴齊來」和「招財金菠蘿」。主持還請來宋熙年到來暢談在外國過年的難忘事。「迎新年八件事」主持介紹多款特色水果。

programme.title: 家家行運菜粵
programme.desc: 所謂「民以吃為天」，若能在農曆新年期間，品嚐到不同的傳統菜式，絕對是迎新歲的最好方法！主持麥長青、王君馨和吳業坤馬年率先「驛馬星動」，為大家穿梭全港各區屋邨、漁村、圍村、農村等地方，就每集主題如頭盤、海鮮、家禽、燉湯、甜點等，向各家各戶「取經」，拆解不同家庭的美味賀年菜式的秘密，讓你在新年先行吃運，大飽口福！此外，每集主持還會請來「行運」嘉賓炮製「自家賀年菜」，與大家分享他們獨門的烹調秘訣！

programme.title: 萬千星輝頒獎典禮2025粵
programme.desc: 《新聞女王2》橫掃九個獎項，成2025台慶頒獎禮大贏家。除了囊括香港、大灣區兩個劇集獎項，佘詩曼、黃宗澤同封「雙料視帝、視后」。何廣沛、王敏奕首奪「最佳男、女配角」，由詹天文主唱的電視歌曲亦得獎。「最佳男、女主持」方面，車婉婉爆喊當選，林盛斌激動領獎震撼全場！吳業坤、葉蒨文成功「飛躍」，「男、女新人」則落在馮皓揚、劉洋、倪嘉雯手裡。曾志偉榮膺「萬千光輝榮譽傳奇」，獲譚詠麟現身頒獎兼獻歌，場面動人！

programme.title: 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 選擇大灣區安老院舍除了考慮環境和服務，交通及生活配套亦非常重要。今集主持徐榮介紹的一所六星級康養中心，直通巴士站、商場、食肆都近在咫尺，讓長者能夠享受精彩充實的安老生活。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 蘇民峰師傅繼續細談馬年生肖運程，屬雞者是好運榜首？狗是重桃花的生肖，但同時要慎防六粒凶星！屬豬人士將「表明風光，地位提升」，是好還是壞？年初二，桃李滿門的低音大提琴導師，找來四名學生合作演奏中國民謠<鳳陽花鼓；其中兩位還是其公子，從小就習琴。要學好低音大提琴，時間管理最重要！眾學生還分享學習得着，以及出外表演的深刻點滴。「睇餸食飯」，潮州菜師傅許美德以龍蝦及馬蹄，示範賀年菜「龍馬精神」。

programme.title: 中年好聲音3紅白大戰粵
programme.desc: 下半場先來「國風對決」，曹越、劉曉昆、陳嘉琦的<糖不甩，穿上戲曲服飾的趙浚承、陸東成等以<新禪院鐘聲應戰。緊接是「四王四后」比拼，兩隊各派四人模仿九十年代天王、天后，星味十足。善玥澄、劉曉昆、阮慧珊、侯靜伊、鍾凱瑩化身性感女團送上<似火探戈和<烈焰紅唇，這場「熱舞激戰」白隊會如何應對？終極回合的「夢想解碼」，兩隊會合力演繹動人舞台劇。另外，陳芷盈、占士丁丁會帶來為登峯之戰準備的決勝快歌。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子得知中野先生家裡冷清，適逢節分來臨，便偕同爺爺跑到對方家為其撒豆驅鬼、迎春接福。小丸子為了豐富茶點，決定暫時不用被爐，爺爺帶小丸子到房裡用火鉢取暖煎茶，讓她認識到火鉢的魅力。

programme.title: 灼熱卡巴迪粵日
programme.desc: 宵越和畦道的一年級隊，與水澄和伊達的二年級隊進行練習比賽，卻以大比數差距慘敗。雖然宵越對合作感到抗拒，但他深知如要獲勝，就必須與畦道建立團隊默契。宵越與畦道繼而展開秘密特訓，向二年級隊提出挑戰！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 過農曆新年時，總會見到蘿蔔糕、芋頭糕等糕點，原來與同音字「高」有關，寓意地位提升。至於拜年常見的攢盒(全盒)，為何會放入油炸食物及糖漬食物？每一件放進去的東西，即使是不能吃的利是和桔，都別有寓意！對本地文化甚有研究的蕭欣浩博士逐一講解。春節傳統習俗上，初三會拜神祈福，初七會慶祝「人日」，背後可有甚麼故事？年十五「元宵」亦被稱為「中國情人節」，古時男女相聚花燈會互表心意，也會吃象徵甜蜜團圓的湯圓。

programme.title: 忍者亂太郎粵日
programme.desc: 雪鬼和雨鬼被其他城堡的忍者招攬過檔。新丁出奇地在測驗中取得全班最高的分數，但新丁自己也不明白為什麼會有這樣的成績。亂太郎他們走捷徑返回忍術學校，途中意外發現了一間大屋及形跡可疑的人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 長沙灣有新盤一房，洗衣機喉管漏水浸濕地台，洗手間櫃底也堆積垃圾，為何如此？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港賽馬會呈獻:「馬到功成耀香江」馬年煙花匯演粵
programme.desc: 2026馬年煙花匯演於大年初二(1月18日)晚上八時，在維多利亞港上空舉行。本年新春煙花匯演主題是「馬到功成耀香江」，共分八幕，總共發放31,888枚煙花。除了首幕《駿馬啟程》有15秒高密度開幕煙花與禮花彈層層推進，營造駿馬初出、萬馬奔騰的形象之外，歷時23分鐘的匯演還可看到「8」字型、金元寶圖案、星光、大錦冠的耀目煙花效果。節目直擊煙花璀璨的盛況，和香港民眾一起感受春節熱鬧氣氛，共同歡度新歲。

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#22粵PG
programme.desc: 希仁獲挽留，得以檢控龐喆，頌星引咎辭職。龐喆設法自救，詎料……子廉猝逝，其父趙德賢的前妻李妃宸攜子趙子禮回來，認回德賢。子禮行山失蹤，後被發現屍體，熊飛展開調查。善昱取得龐喆的股權，有意成為集團主席的接任人。妃宸告知希仁與熊飛，子禮與她及德賢竟無血緣關係，懷疑當年人工受孕過程中出錯！子幀被要求過繼給德賢，以成為集團繼承人，他驚覺德敬並非全無野心，擔心德敬為讓他成為接班人而犯錯，公孫珀勸他查明真相。

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#14粵普PG
programme.desc: 韶光拒絕了柳豐的求親；韶光向林晏提及關於洗碗機的事，沒想到他竟然真的造了出來；林晏使計令長公主交出尺牘，亦讓趙王發現林晏開始對自己起疑；林晏打算為崔家平反後，就向韶光提親；沈家迎來在永安的第一場雪…

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻：一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 大年初二，玲玲師傅相約洪天明、周家蔚夫婦同吃開年飯。天明細談父親洪金寶堅持傳統禮節，晚輩要向長輩跪拜敬茶賀年，並透露父親望添一名孫女，遂向師傅探問玄機。碧霞師傅稱家中門口忌放雨傘、鞋等，即使揮春亦只宜貼至正月十五？丞丞師傅與展望、蒨文新春行大運遊覽佛山三水，了解魁崗文塔的歷史及風水故事，還嘗試用蔥、芹、粽子祈福的當地習俗。雲文子師傅帶來2026年貓狗催運貼士；還有元海伉儷送上馬年家居旺位佈陣錦囊。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#3粵
programme.desc: 元宗與嚴平兩敗俱傷，善柔殺嚴平取其頭臚領賞金。元宗臨終送木劍及鉅子令給少龍。少龍責善柔見利忘義害死元宗，憤然離去。少龍誤打誤撞助灰鬍擒烏氏家將陶方及大小姐烏廷芳，原來灰鬍是馬賊及受僱奪取和氏璧，少龍使計助陶方及廷芳逃走，得知和氏璧用來交換秦質子嬴政，答應替陶方取回。灰鬍的僱主取得和氏璧後殺人滅口，陶方推測此人是趙國巨鹿侯趙穆的手下連晉，二人跟蹤連晉，驚見他打造假和氏璧及殺工匠滅口。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#4粵
programme.desc: 少龍見連晉欲私吞和氏璧，使計將真假和氏璧調包。陶方帶少龍回烏家堡拜會主人烏應元，廷芳不滿少龍詆譭連晉。連晉將假和氏璧交給趙穆，少龍在趙王面前略施小計即令烏家脫罪，趙穆暗氣。少龍不值王妹趙雅之子趙盤欺負少女，仗義教訓之。少龍隨應元入宮飲宴，被一美宮女吸引。原來她是廷芳好友公主趙倩。趙穆與少龍、應元為應否放嬴政母子返秦爭拗，趙穆乘機慫恿少龍與連晉在御前比劍，連晉應戰揮劍劈向少龍的腦門。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 齋是農曆新年的常見菜式，本集Gigi姐會示範烹煮現代版本，例如以前的齋是有髮菜的，但現在因為保護環境而不會再用。而傳統的齋總給人油膩的感覺，Gigi姐教大家挑選比較健康又耐熱的油，最適合用來做這道齋。

programme.title: 鼎爺做節攻略粵
programme.desc: 鼎爺以櫻花蝦、梅菜、五花腩、豆腐四種簡單食材炮製出宴客佳餚。留意鹹梅菜與甜梅菜的比例，切碎後以白鑊烘乾，然後與五花腩拌勻舖在豆腐上蒸熟，最後淋上泡油後的櫻花蝦是精粹所在！緊接鼎爺製作「黃金豆腐」，豆腐先浸在滷水中至入味，切粒後蘸脆漿炸香，配上XO醬同吃別有一番風味。以雞入饌可謂過節必備，鼎爺特以雞項製作「蔥油雞」。留意蒸雞方法，雞隻蒸好後斬件，接着淋上文火炸香的蔥油，蔥香配嫩滑雞肉味道一流！

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 「香港鬼才」黃霑為樂壇留下大量優秀的音樂作品，首首歌曲都耐人尋味，區瑞強、林一峰、林二汶、杜麗莎、李龍基、胡琳、袁麗嫦，以及霑叔第一任妻子華娃，分別演繹霑叔創作的經典歌曲。主持人則論盡霑叔的傳奇往事。

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: 雙祥大整賀年食物-年糕及蘿蔔糕，一於祝節目收視步步高升，亦由此引申到圈中藝人平步青雲、步步高升的幸運例子。

programme.title: 雙祥見粵

programme.title: 2025香港小姐競選決賽粵
programme.desc: 張敬軒以美妙歌聲揭開本屆決賽序幕，十四位準港姐閃耀登場。佳麗才藝比拼，現代舞、古箏、花式跳繩、藝術體操、Rap唱夠驚艷；緊接配合李治廷的歌聲奉上繽紛Catwalk演出，並訴說夢想中的無限可能。十強佳麗晉身「海底世界」，在泳裝答問環節展口才和美態，再於衛蘭靚聲引領下漫遊「童話仙境」，還有鄺美雲獻聲助興。五強終極拉票，最終陳詠詩冠軍加冕，施宇琪、袁文靜分獲亞、季軍，李尹嫣則成「最上鏡小姐兼友誼小姐」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 大年初三，蘇民峰師傅繼續亮相節目，為屬鼠、屬牛、屬虎的觀眾帶來馬年生肖運程。預測涵蓋事業、愛情、健康等範疇，並提出建議錦囊，據說其中一個生肖在這年有機會財源滾滾！中式書法多以平面呈現，有藝術家嘗試將傳統書法立體化，希望做到一筆一劃皆可觀賞，既具美感又保留書意。藝術家到臨細談從陶泥、木材到鐵材的製字經歷，並展示以鐵材製成的字雕塑作品，分享創作心得。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨示範「日系山椒南瓜雞肉煮」。

programme.title: 一班好聲音「十」力無限演唱會粵
programme.desc: 十位「中一生」發放「火熱動感」，更無懼突破。李佳、羅啟豪、顏志恒、林鉫徫無伴奏打造<天梯；龍婷、支嚳儀韓風舞動<失憶周末。丁文俊、魏嘉信操肌特訓玩<脫掉；吳大強逆齡夥拍支支Rap唱<係咁先啦。周吉佩除挑戰拉丁舞，與志恒、嘉信跳唱<忘情森巴舞時，還獲各自愛妻伴舞。「中二四大天王」獻聲撐場，玩轉<廣播道Fans殺人事件。回望好聲音追夢之旅，中一生<不再猶豫，也對支持者呼喊<無言感激！

programme.title: 灼熱卡巴迪粵日
programme.desc: 宵越一邊練習一邊摸索「勝利」的路徑，反而愈來愈焦躁，井浦見狀，便建議宵越發展自身優勢，成為最強突襲者。數天後，宵越跑步時意外撞倒一個完全沒有氣息的瘦弱男子，而此人的真實身份竟是……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 農曆新年期間，大家享用了不少高熱量的賀年美食，是時候跟隨「WORKOUT 2GETHER」鍛練，保持身體健康。基礎體適能訓練中，波比跳、原地跳等動作都需連續做出，玲玲姐姐完成後直言有點氣喘，但教練提醒，唯有達至這強度才可有效促進新陳代謝。接着還會利用阻力帶強化肌力，針對手臂、大腿、腹部進行鍛練，有甚麼相關動作？本集亦帶來AI生成動畫《年獸的故事》下半部，究竟留在村中的伯伯將如何對付兇猛的年獸？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 正當陽葵三人分享贏得美人魚大賽造型的喜悅之際，陽葵想到一個疑問，就是每次大賽的獎品，到底是由誰人挑選。根據四眼姐姐說法，這是「委員會」的工作。而委員會的成員，就是DJ荷特、史派西P與馬卡龍女士三人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新聞，明日歷史」。每天那麼多新聞，大家可能來不及消化，更遑論回望歷史。歷史就是一個大寶庫，少看歷史和小看歷史，很容易「走寶」。新節目《新聞掏寶》帶大家在寶庫「掏」新聞寶藏，除了昔日特輯、直播和系列報道，還有從未曝光的珍貴片段，觀眾有機會重溫李小龍出殯、寶生銀行劫案、四人幫審訊、英女王訪港、的士罷駛、中英簽訂聯合聲明、戴卓爾夫人專訪、越南難民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、啟德機場關閉、鄧小平逝世、九七回歸大典、華航香港空難和沙士記者會。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2747粵
programme.desc: 過年前，樹根向街坊鄰里「挑起事端」，原來另有圖謀。因樹根之故，城安的利是收入大減，需要設法增加「進賬」。熊家的親戚大多移居海外，城安向三舅公越洋拜年，成功討得利是，卻令樹根大破慳囊。不少海外親戚欲向樹根越洋拜年，城安想到一個「低成本」派利是的解決方法，詎料……大四喜出埠表演，當地卻因某些原因禁止新年習俗。其後，城安致電樹根，稱海外一眾親戚親身前來要向樹根拜年，提醒樹根切勿回來……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#23粵PG
programme.desc: 希仁找到為妃宸進行人工受孕的生殖學家程國揆。國揆是趙舟的好友，提到自己早已認識希仁……妃宸懷疑人工受孕出錯是趙舟指使，希仁往找趙舟對質！善昱找龐喆，商量如何爭奪慶曆；子幀意外發現身世有可疑，向德敬問明真相。熊飛搜集趙舟陷害妃宸的證據，胚胎學家錢藝珠此時打算離港。逸桐發現義兄們往生殖醫學中心縱火，通知熊飛阻止，自己亦身陷險境……希仁試探國揆，國揆招認過錯，並說出令希仁震驚的真相！

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#15粵普
programme.desc: 沈家人發現韶光與林晏互生情愫，決意搬走。林晏問韶光為何躲著自己，韶光的違心話讓他黯然神傷。韶傑因牙人酷似前妻而被騙錢，因此大受刺激。曹融發現或有許多兵卒假死，趙荀之牽扯其中，林晏決定悄悄接近查探。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻：一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 年初三「赤口」，丞丞師傅帶展望、蒨文到訪肇慶悅城的龍母祖廟，並細述龍母的傳說故事。據稱摸龍母床可保祐生育，有何宜忌？風水玄學認為家居隱藏病位，楓燧師傅分享其檢測病位「法寶」及化解佈陣。玲玲師傅率眾遊逛深圳的花卉小鎮，細談買年花、養魚、擺放植物的心得，提醒忌於電腦旁放多肉盆栽？想添新年財，碧霞師傅推薦其「心水」旺財投注地區，以及幸運號碼與顏色。女士如想招桃花，雲文子師傅有其噴香水玄學見解，可供參考。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#5粵
programme.desc: 趙穆責連晉沒趁機殺少龍。應元見少龍蹴鞠的球技了得，請他訓練家將，廷芳及其兄廷威均不滿。廷芳叫連晉買藥教訓少龍，連晉卻買下毒藥給她。少龍夜探質子府遇陶方，少龍訛稱是秦相呂不韋派來的密探。少龍挑選精英以訓練蹴鞠為名，實則訓練拯救贏政的死士。廷芳在少龍的肉湯下藥，意外打翻，小狗舐吃後毒發身亡，廷芳質問連晉，連晉巧言脫罪。廷芳與廷威硬要加入蹴鞠訓練隊伍，少龍遂與廷芳打賭。廷芳入宮探望趙倩，大數少龍的不是。

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#6粵
programme.desc: 廷芳完成考核，要少龍跳崖，少龍即縱身跳下，廷芳大驚。廷芳被少龍所騙，大罵他「衰人」。少龍以現代踢足球方法教眾人蹴鞠，廷芳與廷威表懷疑。比賽日，趙盤及王子趙嘉打賭。盤母趙雅令眾生傾倒，公子趙德嘲笑趙盤有名風騷娘親，趙盤憤怒。少龍等節節領先，連晉偷襲，少龍借口受傷出，與陶方趕往質子府救人遭埋伏，並赫見善柔。趙穆借問候少龍傷勢到烏家查探，幸少龍早有對策。廷芳偷聽少龍與應元等對話，驚悉秘密，對少龍改觀。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 唔玩唔知身體好，唔測唔知時運高。陳嘉桓、連詩雅用求籤方式配對隊員後，進行連串「身體檢查遊戲」。氣球及石春路結合，證實連詩雅很久沒有夜蒲，亦看出張振朗、何浩文身體不濟。牙膏放在地上任踩，有人聲勢大卻得低分數，甚至有負分出現！張振朗跳群體竹舞時兩度連累隊友，還高呼錯不在他！罪魁禍首是甚麼？何君誠及何浩文頭戴VR眼鏡玩平衡木，當中有人極度畏高，甚至飆冷汗！出線一隊向許願樹拋橙，神明會否保佑他們收到禮物？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 女王之家(完)
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧(完)
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 豬豬俠之超星五靈俠S1
programme.desc: 豬豬俠與同伴接收到來自九霄星的求救信號，儘管他們已經失去了強大的超能力，但熱心腸的豬豬們仍然義無反顧地再次啓航，前往那個充滿未知數的陌生星球。來到九霄星後，豬豬們看到了整個星球的地表都被灼熱的岩漿覆蓋，而空中竟然懸浮着許多壯觀宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，這些天空之城正在陸續失去能讓它們懸浮的五靈元素，面臨墜毀的威脅。豬豬俠等人尋找背後的原因，並耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪惡力量，使出渾身解數拯救天空之城。一場守護正義、保護天空之城的全新冒險之旅開始啦。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 只屬於我的你

programme.title: 女王之家(完)
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高銀與朴海鎮領銜，知名主角群展現校園青春浪漫！！】大學新生洪雪面對完美又腹黑的劉正學長，因獨特魅力逐漸受他吸引。隨著兩人情意漸濃，劉正的神秘性個性和控制慾逐漸浮出水面，兩人微妙的心理戰，以及性格不羈同學的白仁浩再洪雪身邊守候，三人的矛盾、最終洪雪情歸何處?

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 韓國小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李聖旻社區大叔們聯手打造韓國小姐】高中時自恃美貌過人，而沒有好好唸書的吳智英，畢業後憑藉外表當上百貨的電梯小姐，看似光鮮亮麗的工作，背後隱藏著許多辛酸，面對毛手毛腳的變態上司，以及百貨種種不合理的工作規定，年紀增長且缺乏競爭力另吳智英後悔莫及，偶然的機會下，與現職化妝品公司社長的前男友相遇，公司即將倒閉的金亨俊，與債主鄭先生一同把平凡女孩打造為頂級韓國小姐的勵志故事。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龍！都會家庭的高考大作戰】以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張。另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難。最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想。這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭、親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻。

programme.title: The Holcroft Covenant
programme.desc: The son of a German general becomes part of a mysterious conspiracy to find hidden Nazi funds.

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: As a nurse, Coffy (Pam Grier) has seen the ill effects of drugs up close, but it isn't until her little sister becomes addicted to heroin that she finally decides to wage a one-woman battle. Disguised as a prostitute, Coffy goes on a killing rampage, at first going after street dealers and pimps such as sleazy King George (Robert DoQui), then gradually working her way up to bigger honchos. She's shocked, however, when she discovers that her politician boyfriend (Booker Bradshaw) is involved.

programme.title: The Assassination Bureau
programme.desc: Ivan is a self-confident chief of an association of hit men for hire, who will refuse no well-paid offer--especially the lucrative challenge of an aspiring reporter. Reasoning that a running cat-and-mouse duel with his henchmen will rid the organization of incompetents, Ivan agrees to become the object of a nonstop hunt.

programme.desc: Dr. Steven Sorenson (Andrews) plans to tap the geothermal energy of the Earth's interior by means of a thermonuclear device detonated deep within the Earth. programme.title: Kids' Planet - Love - EP120
programme.desc: In this episode, we will learn about the value of love. We will understand that when we have love in our hearts, we care about the well-being of others, so we make them happy. Respect is a big part of love and when love is in our heart, there is no place for negative feelings.

programme.desc: It's the exceptional painter, Spinach, creating Kiwi's portrait, if Kiwi can keep still.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Chicory
programme.desc: It's Chicory singing about how she was discovered in the song "Chicory, Dickory, Dock!"

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Evil Pea's Big Freeze
programme.desc: Evil Pea freezes the veggies so she can take over the whole supermarket. Chilli's heat unfreezes Supertato who then races on lolly-stick skis to thwart Evil Pea and save the day.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Cheese Moon
programme.desc: It's a space race as Supertato helps Carrot fly her baguette rocket to be the first Veggie on the Cheese Moon but half way there Evil Pea crashes into them making them crash land.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Songtime
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dispy, Laa‐Laa and Po enjoy Tiddlytubbies Songtime. Then it is time for Teletubbies Songtime. The Teletubbies sing solo before singing all together.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobra's blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his father's old rival.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji; and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a pretty fraud, steals a brilliant diamond ring from a shop in Hong Kong and escapes to Singapore. To smuggle the ring pass customs, Hua slips it into the pocket of a stranger, Yen, but then lost track of him. Hua finally spots Yen after searching for days and does everything to get close to him in order to take the ring back.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiance. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nu's elder sister hopes to restore the clan's honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Nightmare of Darkness
programme.desc: A young actress’ Weibo account is refreshed with a new post three years after her death, disclosing her dating picture with young idol Wu Zi Zhen. Wu seeks help from the PR consultant Qiao Shen at his haunted house, but encounters a series of horrifying incidents. After being interrogated by Qiao, Wu lowers his guard and unveils a shocking secret...

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jim is excited to test-drive a Vespa for his birthday but things quickly go awry when he must fight Bular's flying Vulture Troll sent to hunt him down.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Young Atlas
programme.desc: Jim uses a courage-enhancing "Grit Shaka" to accelerate his training, but nearly gets himself killed when he hunts down Bular and Toby must save him.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Key To The Strip
programme.desc: The kids battle Shashi in Las Vegas as Shashi tries to take down evil billionaire Cleve and use Skeleton Key to create a new world order. Frostee has a plan to get Skeleton Key offline, but it only gives Tony ten seconds to take Shashi out and save the world.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Escape from L.A.
programme.desc: Tony and his crew have been working as spy racers in LA for a while now and are itching to go international. Whey they discover a mysterious man with a strange tattoo of a formula in a smuggling ring bust, Ms. Nowhere finally agrees to let them go to Rio to investigate the tattoo and the whereabouts of one of her agents who has gone dark - Layla Gray.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - That Sinking Feeling
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere drops the kids off in Brazil and leaves to go on her own important mission, but things immediately go south for Tony and his crew. When the hauler and gear gets caught in quicksand, Tony needs to learn that a good leader knows when to accept help.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Whimsy Wasps Freeze Tag
programme.desc: When a type of insect (Whimsy Wasps) become attracted to Trolls Village due to the Trolls’ joyful lifestyles, Branch must convince them to tone it down in order to avoid being descended upon by a swarm of the wasps. For the first time in Trolls Village, a game of freeze tag has broken out without the tagger declaring themselves. Poppy races to discover the identity of the mysterious tagger, before all of Trolls Village ends up frozen

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Back To The Starting Line
programme.desc: As a new term begins, Maricela and her horse, Mystery, arrive at the academy to join Lucky, Pru and Abigail for the school year.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - The Road Home
programme.desc: Team Voltron attempts to set off on the journey to Earth, but when they land on a Blades checkpoint to rest they find themselves being chased

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Makeover
programme.desc: Liam starts acting even stranger when he falls in love with an older woman:15-year-old Cynthia. Birch, Sandra and Raffi conspire to give Liam a complete makeover to make him more appealing. Their plans backfire, making Liam look crazy instead of attractive.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Pom-Pom Girl
programme.desc: Sandra rises to the challenge of becoming a cheerleader, an act that stuns and mortifies her podmates. As Sandra succumbs to Amelia's ridiculous hazing rituals Pod 4 becomes increasingly uneasy. But we soon learn that Sandra is only doing back flips to ensure her nemesis' ultimate humiliation.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Unreasonable Facsimilies
programme.desc: Overhearing Mr. Towes' plan to throw a pop quiz Raffi uses the information to his advantage - by studying. However, Raffi's current obsession with texting has him including his own acronyms in his answers, thus creating irrefutable evidence for the teacher. Guilt finally undoes the pod with unlikely results.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Planets Maligned
programme.desc: After a less than stellar day, Birch finds consolation in the pages of The Gemini Daily Planner she finds while cleaning her room. Impressed with its seeming accuracy, soon she won't make a move without consulting the book much to the escalating annoyance of the pod. A startling last-minute revelation keeps the pod from blowing apart.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Naughty Twins
programme.desc: Stingo is frustrated that he is always getting caught trying to take food from the other tots. He persuades the twins to go round the garden for him collecting food… will the other tots realise what he is up to?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Shadows
programme.desc: Webby is clearing out her web. Fifi takes all the unwanted objects home and uses them to play a brilliant game of shadow puppets, a perfect game to play on a rainy day!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Fifi's Happy Day
programme.desc: Primrose has decided to hold a party for Fifi. Everyone is helping get it ready, even Stingo and Slugsy who are in charge of making the cake. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Fly High Primrose
programme.desc: Fifi, Bumble and Violet are trying to pick all the blackberries before the wind blows them to the ground. But soon they have something very different to catch as Primrose flies past!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Lovelorn Slugsy
programme.desc: Slugsy is having trouble courting Primrose. Stingo's cousin Hornetto offers to help him. But could he be up to no good?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Fifi's Snowy Fun
programme.desc: It has snowed in Flowertot Garden and all the tots are having fun… except Primrose who is worried she'll get dirty. Can the other tots convince her to play with them?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Mystery In Flowertot Garden
programme.desc: Somebody has been going through the tots' bins every night in Flowertot Garden. The tots turn detective to see if they can discover who the culprit is.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Stingo Cleans Up
programme.desc: Diggly has had enough of the heap of unwanted items next to his compost heap. Stingo decides to "resell" them to the other tots and unwittingly helps everybody out!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Explores The Attic
programme.desc: Olivia searches high and low for Grandma's missing time capsule, and eventually finds it tucked away, forgotten, in the attic. Olivia is puzzled and thrilled by the objects that she finds from Grandmother's childhood, and is inspired to create her own time capsule.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Good Luck
programme.desc: Olivia is determined to sell more Young Pioneers cookies than anybody else in her troupe - especially Francine. It turns out to be harder than she thought it would be, but with a little perseverance and ingenuity, Olivia manages to do her personal best.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Mecha-Menace
programme.desc: Magnus and Axel unveil their new "mechano-dragon." It's impressive at first, but the Riders set out to prove it's no better than a bucket of bolts.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Peril Patch Sibling Quibbling
programme.desc: When a mysterious, dangerous mini-golf course blooms in Troll Village, the Trolls must figure out how to destroy itSatin's relationship with Chenille is tested when she befriends an extreme sports-loving Troll

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Musical Thrones Branch Bum
programme.desc: Poppy hosts the biggest contest of the year for the chance to with a cool new hug watchThe Snack Pack go on a Caterbus road-trip and get sucked into a wormhole

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Not My Boy Brandon Shady Shawn
programme.desc: Tip and Oh get an annoying "tagalong" friend who won't leave them aloneThe Tucci's go camping with Lucy's new boyfriend

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - B.R.A.P. It's A Booviful Life
programme.desc: Oh is stuck in an alternate universe; Oh's new ranking as most respected Boov Rapper in Chicago is threatened

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Ore Hunt
programme.desc: Garby accidentally leads D-Structs and D-Stroy to the base, but the Trux find a way to fight back by keeping a special ore away from the D-Bros.

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Ty Vs. D-Structs
programme.desc: When Revvit gets kidnapped by the D-Brothers, Ty embarks on a dangerous mission that leads to a final showdown with D-Structs.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Sea Monsters Puff Fruit
programme.desc: Rumors of scary sea monsters in the East End take the kids on a journey of discovering you shouldn’t believe everything you hear. Mysterious globs disturbing the ocean turn out to be the byproduct of food from Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Chef J's Tale
programme.desc: Chef J tells a tale about unicorns sailing in ships on clouds in search of Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Chaser And Chewer Recipe For Adventure
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch pretend to be their favorite comic book heroes and help the dogs of Pawston. But when Frank and Beans pretend to be villains it’s up to Chaser and Chewer to stop the trouble makers and save the day. \ It’s Bring Your Own Bowl Night at the Barker house, and Tag and Grandmaw team up to make Great Great Auntie Eunice's Famous Far Fetched Cookies. But the obscure ingredients are hard to find, so they have to team up and go on an adventure.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Raiders of the Lost Bark Slow, Dog. Slow!
programme.desc: When Tag and Scooch break Gilber’s ancient Golden Slipper, they embark on an adventure to a secret cave to retrieve the matching slipper. \ For community outreach day, the Race Cadets are paired with an elderly resident of Pawston. It's Tag and Scooch's job to take old dog Leo around town for a day of slow, relaxing activities. But when Leo wants to kickbarx, row and skydive, Tag and Scooch try their best to keep up.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Great Paper Chase Home Is Where Ken's Heart Is
programme.desc: When Rodney draws and writes his own comic book, TZG secretly helps him transport it to the comic book store where creator Ken KaBlam is on the hunt for new talent. When Ken KaBlam gets homesick for his own hometown of Crostonburg, TZG secretly recreates the things me misses in Harmony Harbor.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - That Stinking Feeling Go for The Gold
programme.desc: When Donna is dog sitting but unable to sleep due to barking, TZG secretly stops a skunk from sneaking into her yard at night and riling the pooch. When an inexperienced Rona takes over as chairman of the Founder’s Day Celebration, TZG secretly helps ensure the traditional festivities run smoothly.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Glitter Guide Piano Panic
programme.desc: When the Dews find out their glitter guide (an older Dew Drop) is coming to visit, they bend over backwards to make a great first impression, but end up forgetting some of their responsiblities in the process. When a string breaks on Marcus’ piano before his recital and he can’t practice, the Dews must lead Marcus to a new piano.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Dew Drops Day Off Up All Night
programme.desc: When the Dew Drops have the day off, they discover their families still need their help when they’re not around. Harper needs a good night’s sleep before her first day of Cooking Camp. But when an overtired Nicholas keeps her awake, the Dews must help keep Nicholas quiet, even if it takes all night.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Dawn Of The Broods Part 1 & Part 2
programme.desc: Grug convinces The Croods to go on vacation, and they find a new family, The Broods, who live in a solitary utopia too good to be trueThe Croods must escape and warn Ahhh! Valley before it's too late.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Gran Day Out
programme.desc: When Gran moves into the cave with The Croods, she drives Grug nuts and embarrasses Eep in front of the first-ever group of cool kids.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - North of the Border
programme.desc: With his identity as a fugitive businessman exposed, Boss Baby has been hiding out in the lawless land of Canada.
